criteria.name: findings_coverage
criteria.description: All 3 findings covered with correct severity (High/Medium/Low); evidence referenced accurately; risk impact clearly stated

criteria.name: recommendation_quality
criteria.description: Recommendations are specific and actionable (not 'add notifications' but 'send Telegram notification on every block event when silentBlock=true'); technically sound

criteria.name: report_structure
criteria.description: All 5 required sections present; remediation priority matrix is complete and logical; professional format

criteria.name: positive_findings
criteria.description: Positive findings are credible and grounded in the plugin description (multi-layer scanning, credential redaction working correctly, etc.)

criteria.name: tone_and_length
criteria.description: Professional, precise tone appropriate for security report; 600-900 words; no vague language; conclusion gives clear production readiness verdict
